2116647408465563761.en_summary: US companies are facing a massive debt maturity wall: ~$1.9 trillion in US speculative-grade corporate bonds and loans mature over the next 5 years, including $438 billion due by the end of 2028. Junk-rated debt maturing within 2 years surged +31% YoY. $1.6 trillion of investment-grade corporate debt due by 2031. Refinancing expensive, effective yield on US junk debt +150 bps to 8.0% over last 12 months. Corporate refinancing burden is becoming a major issue.
2116647408465563761.zh_summary: 美國公司面臨巨大的債務到期牆：未來 5 年約 1.9 兆美元美國投機級公司債券與貸款到期，包括 2028 年底前到期的 4380 億美元。2 年內到期的垃圾級債務同比激增 +31%。到 2031 年有 1.6 兆美元投資級公司債務到期。再融資變得越來越昂貴，過去 12 個月美國垃圾債務有效收益率上升 150 個基點至 8.0%。公司再融資負擔正成為重大問題。
